authentication.freshness: The host supplies a fresh non-zero 32-byte nonce for every connection and accepts only an exact echo in the response.
authentication.guestIdentity: The host connects through the VZVirtioSocketDevice attached to the exact VM whose kernel and read-only root disk it verified immediately before start. The complete three-artifact tuple also binds the verified but direct-boot-unused initrd.
authentication.hostIdentity: The guest accepts only the kernel-reported AF_VSOCK peer CID VMADDR_CID_HOST (2).
authentication.protocolBinding: Every request and response carries the SHA-256 digest of this complete contract.
authentication.replayBoundary: A response from another nonce, boot tuple, protocol contract, VM, or frame kind is rejected.
